certificado.titulo: You have finished the course. Your certificate is ready.
certificado.texto: It carries your name and can be checked with a link. Add it to your LinkedIn profile or share it with anyone.

progreso.certificadosTexto: Certificates for the courses you have finished.

referidos.heroTexto: Share {academia} with someone who would find it useful. When they pay, part of it is yours.

referidos.inactivoTexto: Your academy has not switched it on. If it does, you will see your link and earnings here.

referidos.listaTexto: Each sale you brought in, with its status. No personal details are shown.

pasos.compartesTexto: On WhatsApp, social media or in person.

dudas.cuandoTexto: When someone opens your link. If they pay within the next {days} days, the sale is yours.
dudas.devolucion: What if they ask for a refund?
dudas.devolucionTexto: If they get their money back, your share of that sale is cancelled.
dudas.limiteMeses: You earn during their first {months} months.
dudas.limiteSin: No. As long as they keep paying, you keep earning.
